Resolves #21551

Forms & Fields hid two merged demonstrations because their records had no cover, and Calendar's card showed a 2020 year view inside a browser frame. Recipes for `form-validation`, `field-with-prefix` and `calendar` now capture covers in a dark theme, and the bytes are on neomjs/pages#145, which merges first. The records point at those covers, so Forms & Fields shows three demonstration cards and Calendar shows today's team week. The form app moves ahead of the two new records in `examples.json`, so it stays the group's lead card.

Evidence: L3 (local dev server on this branch with the covers served from the pages branch, headless Chromium, dark, 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844; the covers came from `captureExamples.mjs` recipes) → L3 required (AC-1 and AC-2 are rendered pages). Residual: the deployed Portal, under Post-Merge Validation.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | Outside CI: the Forms & Fields frames below, with Multi-Step Account Form, Sign-up validation and Input masks; the page goes from 28 to 30 live examples. CI pins the three cards and their order in `MainContainerController.spec.mjs` ("publishes the groups with a covered member from one definition source…"). |
| AC-2 | Outside CI: the Calendar frames below. |
| AC-3 | Outside CI: `node buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs --base-url http://localhost:8080 --record <id>` captured each cover twice with the same bytes (sha256 `d666242e2031…`, `e6b97bcf925e…`, `4b265d845f38…`), every `after` check passing. CI validates the committed recipes against the catalog (`CaptureExamples.spec.mjs`, "the committed Grid/Table manifest covers…", which runs `validateCaptureRecipes` on both files). |

## Deltas from ticket

- **The form app leads.** In catalog order the two new cards came first and took the form app's lead slot. Moving its record up keeps it first and leaves the Apps page order as it was; the spec's canonical order list follows.
- **Themes.** The sign-up example boots neo-dark from the color scheme. The masks workbench offers light, dark and neo-light, and the calendar light and dark, so both are captured in `neo-theme-dark`, as the field tiles are.
- **The masks cover types one field.** Back-to-back input into these masks races the worker (defect-note `671786e5`), and a recipe cannot wait for a field's value, so the cover shows the phone mask half typed above the four empty masks.
- **Fresh theme CSS.** My local `dist/development/css` predated #21516, and the first sign-up capture showed near-white error text. The covers come from a `themes.mjs -t all -e dev` rebuild.
- `calendar` joins the captured `families`, and `seo.json`'s forms description now counts 31 (was 29) with the same highlights.
